main_idea: Distillation gives a 21% net win-loss margin on GDPval, in two model families.
ideas: Distillation lifts Nemotron student's GDPval win-loss margin
Same recipe transfers to Qwen family
Student learns from its own generations
Win rate and rubric gains quantify the improvement
summary: Clutter: a method pipeline, extra win-rate and rubric stats, repeated labels, and decorative frames and taglines compete with the two headline results. Missing: the baseline model's name and a clear identity of the Nemotron student.

missing.why: 'vs. base model' never says which model is the baseline.
Card says 'Nano student' but never names the model family size clearly.
